senses.gloss: (v. כְּלֵי) [to be whole,] to confide, be confident.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 9:11">Targ. Ps. IX, 11</cite> <he>ויתכלון</he> Ms. a. Ar. (ed. <he>ויסתכלון</he>, corr. acc.; h. text <he>ויבטחו</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 14:32">Targ. Prov. XIV, 32</cite> <cite ref="V00539"><he>תָּכֵיל</he></cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="V00539"><he>תָּכֵל</he></cite>; h. text <he>חסה</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 28:26">Ib. XXVIII, 26</cite> <he>תכיל</he> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="V00539"><he>תָּכֵיל</he></cite>; ed. Wil. <cite ref="V00539"><he>תָּכֵל</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="B00498"><he>בטח</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 31:11">Ib. XXXI, 11</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 6:5:3">Y. Keth. VI, 30ᵈ</cite> <he>יִתְכּוֹל דמריה דמועדא קיים</he> (not <he>דמועדיא</he>) let one trust that the Lord of the festive season lives, i.e. let the managers of the charities advance or borrow the money, trusting that the charity fund will be repleted at the festive season.
